The National Weather Service has issued a Coastal Flood Advisory for Orange County coastal communities through 5:00 PM Wednesday, September 30.

High tides and elevated surf may cause minor coastal flooding, erosion, strong rip currents, and hazardous swimming conditions.

Residents and visitors should use caution near beaches and low-lying coastal areas, avoid flooded roadways, and follow guidance from local officials and lifeguards.

My office will continue to monitor conditions and share relevant updates. Please follow guidance from local officials and lifeguards and take appropriate precautions to stay safe.
